decisions.reason: It fits the firm's core industrial door range and customer base, so a large German manufacturer would more likely retain and update it than withdraw it, though some overlap with related glazed models creates a modest rationalization risk.
An insulated glazed industrial sectional door matches strong demand for compliant, energy-conscious building solutions and therefore is likely to remain part of the firm's main offer.

Because it had its own dedicated product page and sits close to the firm's core competence in customized industrial door systems, management would likely continue it unless it were folded into a successor line.
